description: feat/dm-edit-events: a DM-removed boon is suppressed from the fold with NO refund (the player already spent the AP), and the SAME boon can be bought again afterward — the retake is not silently dropped. Mirrors EV-017's exact shape (boughtOff/FIFO-by-value) for the new boonRemoved map: buy a boon (25 AP), DM removes it (no cost, no refund), buy the SAME boon again. Only the FIRST purchase is suppressed from the build (FIFO match against dmRemoveBoon's refVal); the retake stays active. Expected: the build holds the boon once (from the retake only); economy() reads earned=50, spent=50 (BOTH purchases counted — spent is never reduced by a removal, only buyoff refunds), available=0. Before this feature existed, dmRemoveBoon was not a recognised event type at all, so this fixture could not be constructed.

events.label: DM removed boon — Boon of Combat Prowess
